name: Soothing Bots
summary:
Soothing Bots is a mixed-reality music experience for Meta Quest. A choir of kind little robot heads moves into your room and sings you story songs. Wake them, hush them and arrange them with your hands or your controllers.

**Sixteen robots, one neighbourhood.** Every song is sung by the same cast: a family, their grandparents, aunties and neighbours. Meet Teddy, who knows every dinosaur; Grandma Pearl, who can't say no; Grandpa Lou, who runs the diner; and Murphy, the unluckiest delivery driver in town. E
